title: editor layout redesign phase four

commit.merge_subject: merge: editor layout redesign phase four

description:
Category polish per owner request 2026-11-11d sections 13-15,
presentation only - every control, default, algorithm and processing
path is untouched (section 14.2/15.1/15.2/15.3 behavior contracts).

Per-category scroll positions (section 11.6 "relevant scroll
position"): EditorPanelSheet now takes the active category and a
per-category ScrollState map owned by the screen as three
rememberSaveable ScrollStates (ScrollState.Saver), so switching
category restores that category's own offset instead of inheriting
the previous one's, each category keeps its position while the user
edits another, and the offsets survive process death and
configuration change like the panel state itself.

Percent readouts (section 12.3 shows "100%"): Noise Reduction,
Chroma Denoise and LUT Strength move from ad-hoc "${v} %" strings
to a new pure Format.formatPercent (Locale.ROOT, no space, no sign),
JVM-tested
changed: feat: pure panel state machine for editor sheet
feat: spec-band slider thumb and pinned toolbar height
feat: draggable editor panel with bottom nav
